title: Heungbu and Nolbu
moral: A kind heart brings good fortune back.
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본(docs/READ_MODE.md §3-4). text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. reuse 는 voice_script_en.json 의 en 그대로, trim 은 같은 문장 경계에서 자른 것, new 만 새로 녹음한다. 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

acts.chick:fall | chick:catch | chick:bandage: 연출(제비 떨어짐·받기·천 감기, 제비 날기, 박씨, 줄기, 박, 톱질, 쌀·보물·새집, 흙탕물, 집 무너짐, 쌀자루 보내기)

lines.text: 옛날 옛날에 마음씨 착한 동생 흥부와 욕심쟁이 형 놀부가 살았어요.
lines.en: Once upon a time, there lived a kind younger brother, Heungbu, and his greedy older brother, Nolbu.
segs: Once upon a time, there lived a kind younger brother, Heungbu, and his greedy older brother, Nolbu.

lines.text: 흥부는 활짝 웃으며 인사했어요.
lines.en: Heungbu smiled and said hello.

lines.text: 흥부네 집은 작고 낡았지만, 아이들 웃음소리가 까르르 넘쳤지요.
lines.en: Heungbu's house was small and shabby, but it was always full of children's giggles, tee-hee.
segs: Heungbu's house was small and shabby, but it was always full of children's giggles, tee-hee.

lines.text: 놀부네 집은 크고 으리으리했지만, 놀부는 늘 흥, 하고 콧방귀만 뀌었어요.
lines.en: Nolbu's house was big and grand, but Nolbu only ever snorted, hmph, hmph.
segs: Nolbu's house was big and grand, but Nolbu only ever snorted, hmph, hmph.

lines.text: 흥부는 배가 고파서 형 집으로 밥을 얻으러 갔어요.
lines.en: Heungbu was hungry, so he went to his brother's house to ask for some rice.
segs: Heungbu was hungry, so he went to his brother's house to ask for some rice.

lines.text: 배에서 꼬르륵꼬르륵 소리가 났어요. "형수님, 밥 한 술만 주세요."
lines.en: His tummy rumbled, grumble, grumble. "Sister-in-law, could I please have just one spoonful of rice?"
segs: Sister-in-law, could I please have just one spoonful of rice?

lines.text: 형수는 화가 난 얼굴로 말했어요. "밥이 어디 있어요! 저리 가요!"
lines.en: His sister-in-law said with an angry face. "There is no rice here! Go away!"
segs: His sister-in-law said with an angry face.
There is no rice here! Go away!

lines.text: 형수가 주걱을 휘두르자 흥부 볼에 밥알이 붙었어요. 흥부는 그 밥알을 맛있게 먹었어요.
lines.en: She waved her rice paddle, and a few grains of rice stuck to Heungbu's cheek. Heungbu ate them happily.
segs: She waved her rice paddle, and a few grains of rice stuck to Heungbu's cheek. Heungbu ate them happily.

lines.text: 흥부는 웃으며 말했어요. "괜찮아요. 밥알도 맛있어요!"
lines.en: Heungbu said with a smile. "It's okay. Even these grains are yummy!"
segs: It's okay. Even these grains are yummy!

lines.text: 흥부는 터벅터벅, 빈손으로 집에 돌아갔어요.
lines.en: Heungbu trudged home, plod, plod, with empty hands.
segs: Heungbu trudged home, plod, plod, with empty hands.

lines.text: 집으로 돌아온 흥부는 처마 밑의 제비들을 바라보았어요.
lines.en: Back home, Heungbu looked at the swallows under his roof.
segs: Back home, Heungbu looked at the swallows under his roof.

lines.text: 흥부네 초가집 처마에는 제비 가족이 살았어요.
lines.en: A swallow family lived under the eaves of Heungbu's little house.
segs: A swallow family lived under the eaves of Heungbu's little house.

lines.text: 아기 제비 세 마리가 짹짹짹, 입을 쩍쩍 벌리며 먹이를 기다렸지요.
lines.en: Three baby swallows chirped, tweet, tweet, tweet, opening their beaks wide for food.
segs: Three baby swallows chirped, tweet, tweet, tweet, opening their beaks wide for food.

lines.text: 앗! 아기 제비 한 마리가 둥지에서 떨어졌어요!
lines.en: Oh no! One baby swallow fell out of the nest!
segs: Oh no! One baby swallow fell out of the nest!

lines.text: 흥부는 깜짝 놀라 마당으로 후다닥 달려갔어요.
lines.en: Heungbu jumped in surprise and dashed out to the yard, quick, quick.
segs: Heungbu jumped in surprise and dashed out to the yard, quick, quick.

lines.text: "아이고, 아프겠다!" 흥부는 아기 제비를 두 손으로 살포시 감쌌어요.
lines.en: "Oh dear, that must hurt!" Heungbu cupped the baby swallow softly in both hands.
segs: Heungbu cupped the baby swallow softly in both hands.

lines.text: 흥부는 아기 제비의 다친 다리에 천을 감아 주었어요. 아기 제비는 금방 나았어요.
lines.en: Heungbu wrapped a cloth around the baby swallow's hurt leg. The baby swallow got better soon.
segs: Heungbu wrapped a cloth around the baby swallow's hurt leg. The baby swallow got better soon.

lines.text: 가을이 되자 제비 가족은 따뜻한 남쪽 나라로 떠났어요.
lines.en: When autumn came, the swallow family flew away to a warm country in the south.
segs: When autumn came, the swallow family flew away to a warm country in the south.

lines.text: 제비들은 흥부네 지붕 위를 빙글 한 바퀴 돌고, 훨훨 날아갔어요.
lines.en: The swallows circled once over Heungbu's roof, round and round, and flew away, flap, flap.
segs: The swallows circled once over Heungbu's roof, round and round, and flew away, flap, flap.

lines.text: "잘 가, 내년에 또 보자!" 흥부는 손을 흔들흔들 흔들었어요.
lines.en: "Goodbye! See you next year!" Heungbu waved and waved his hand.
segs: Heungbu waved and waved his hand.

lines.text: 추운 겨울이 지나고 흥부네 마당에도 봄볕이 들었어요.
lines.en: The cold winter passed, and spring sunshine warmed Heungbu’s yard.
segs: The cold winter passed, and spring sunshine warmed Heungbu’s yard.

lines.text: 봄이 되자 제비가 돌아와서 박씨 하나를 떨어뜨렸어요.
lines.en: When spring came, the swallow flew back and dropped one gourd seed.
segs: When spring came, the swallow flew back and dropped one gourd seed.

lines.text: 박씨가 흥부 손바닥에 또르르 굴러떨어졌어요.
lines.en: The gourd seed rolled, roll, roll, right into Heungbu's palm.
segs: The gourd seed rolled, roll, roll, right into Heungbu's palm.

lines.text: 흥부는 박씨를 마당에 심었어요.
lines.en: Heungbu planted the seed in his yard.
segs: Heungbu planted the seed in his yard.

lines.text: 흥부는 날마다 물을 졸졸 주고, 흙을 토닥토닥 다독였지요.
lines.en: Every day Heungbu watered it, trickle, trickle, and patted the soil, pat, pat.
segs: Every day Heungbu watered it, trickle, trickle, and patted the soil, pat, pat.

lines.text: 시간이 흘러 흥부네 마당의 박 덩굴이 자랐어요.
lines.en: As time passed, the gourd vine grew in Heungbu’s yard.
segs: As time passed, the gourd vine grew in Heungbu’s yard.

lines.text: 줄기가 쑥쑥쑥 자라더니, 커다란 박이 세 통이나 열렸어요!
lines.en: The vine grew and grew, up, up, up, and three big gourds appeared!
segs: The vine grew and grew, up, up, up, and three big gourds appeared!

lines.text: 흥부 부부는 톱으로 박을 탔어요.
lines.from: 흥부 부부는 톱으로 박을 탔어요. 박을 톡! 눌러서 슬근슬근 타 봐요.
lines.en: Heungbu and his wife cut the gourds with a saw.
segs: Heungbu and his wife cut the gourds with a saw.

lines.text: 첫 번째 박에서 하얀 쌀이 쏟아졌어요! 아이들이 신나서 소리쳤어요.
lines.en: White rice poured out of the first gourd! The children shouted with joy.
segs: White rice poured out of the first gourd! The children shouted with joy.

lines.text: 쌀자루가 수북수북, 이제 배불리 먹을 수 있어요.
lines.en: Sacks and sacks of rice, piled up high! Now they could eat until their tummies were full.
segs: Sacks and sacks of rice, piled up high! Now they could eat until their tummies were full.

lines.text: 두 번째 박에서는 반짝반짝 금은보화가 나왔어요!
lines.en: Sparkling gold and jewels came out of the second gourd!
segs: Sparkling gold and jewels came out of the second gourd!

lines.text: 세 번째 박에서는 작은 박 요정들이 나와 멋진 새집을 지어 주었어요!
lines.en: Tiny gourd fairies came out of the third gourd and built a wonderful new house!
segs: Tiny gourd fairies came out of the third gourd and built a wonderful new house!

lines.text: 한편, 놀부와 형수는 자기 집 처마 밑에 있었어요.
lines.en: Meanwhile, Nolbu and his wife stood under their own roof.
segs: Meanwhile, Nolbu and his wife stood under their own roof.

lines.text: 소문을 들은 놀부는 배가 아팠어요. "나도 부자가 될 거야!"
lines.en: When Nolbu heard the news, he felt jealous. "I will be rich too!"
segs: When Nolbu heard the news, he felt jealous.

lines.text: "여보, 제비부터 찾아요!" 형수도 눈을 반짝반짝 빛냈어요.
lines.en: "Dear, go find a swallow first!" Nolbu's wife's eyes sparkled with greed too.
segs: Dear, go find a swallow first!
Nolbu's wife's eyes sparkled with greed too.

lines.text: 놀부는 제비집을 마구 흔들었어요. 아기 제비가 떨어졌어요!
lines.en: Nolbu shook the swallow's nest hard. A baby swallow fell!
segs: Nolbu shook the swallow's nest hard. A baby swallow fell!

lines.text: 놀부는 서둘러 천을 칭칭 감아 주었어요. "자, 이제 박씨를 가져와라!" 제비는 다치지 않고 날아갔어요.
lines.en: Nolbu hurriedly wrapped a cloth around it. "Now bring me a gourd seed!" The swallow was not hurt and flew away.
segs: Nolbu hurriedly wrapped a cloth around it.
Now bring me a gourd seed!
The swallow was not hurt and flew away.

lines.text: 그 뒤 놀부도 박씨를 얻어 자기 집 마당에 심었어요.
lines.en: Later, Nolbu got a gourd seed too and planted it in his yard.
segs: Later, Nolbu got a gourd seed too and planted it in his yard.

lines.text: 놀부네 마당에도 박이 세 통 열렸어요.
lines.en: Three gourds grew in Nolbu's yard too.
segs: Three gourds grew in Nolbu's yard too.

lines.text: "헤헤, 금은보화야, 어서 나와라!" 놀부는 슬근슬근 신나게 톱질했어요.
lines.en: "Hee hee, gold and jewels, come on out!" Nolbu sawed away happily, saw, saw, saw.
segs: Hee hee, gold and jewels, come on out!
Nolbu sawed away happily, saw, saw, saw.

lines.text: 콸콸콸! 박에서 흙탕물이 쏟아져서 놀부가 흠뻑 젖었어요.
lines.en: Splash! Muddy water poured out of the gourd and Nolbu got soaked.
segs: Splash! Muddy water poured out of the gourd and Nolbu got soaked.

lines.text: 이번에는 방망이를 든 도깨비가 쑥 나왔어요. "이 욕심쟁이야!" 도깨비는 놀부를 놀라게 하고 사라졌어요.
lines.en: This time, a Dokkaebi with a club popped out. "You greedy man!" The Dokkaebi gave Nolbu a fright and then disappeared.
segs: This time, a Dokkaebi with a club popped out.
The Dokkaebi gave Nolbu a fright and then disappeared.

lines.text: 놀부는 덜덜 떨면서도 세 번째 박을 탔어요.
lines.en: Shaking and shivering, Nolbu still sawed open the third gourd.
segs: Shaking and shivering, Nolbu still sawed open the third gourd.

lines.text: 와르르! 놀부의 집이 무너졌어요. 다행히 아무도 다치지 않았어요.
lines.en: Crash! Nolbu's house fell down. Luckily, nobody was hurt.
segs: Crash! Nolbu's house fell down. Luckily, nobody was hurt.

lines.text: 놀부는 흙투성이가 되어 흥부네 집을 찾아왔어요.
lines.en: Nolbu, covered in mud, came to Heungbu's house.
segs: Nolbu, covered in mud, came to Heungbu's house.

lines.text: 놀부는 머리를 긁적긁적, 발끝만 내려다보았어요.
lines.en: Nolbu scratched his head, scritch, scratch, and stared down at his toes.
segs: Nolbu scratched his head, scritch, scratch, and stared down at his toes.

lines.text: 놀부가 고개를 숙였어요. "동생아, 내가 잘못했다. 욕심을 부려서 미안하구나."
lines.en: Nolbu bowed his head. "Brother, I was wrong. I am sorry I was so greedy."
segs: Brother, I was wrong. I am sorry I was so greedy.

lines.text: 흥부가 활짝 웃으며 말했어요. "형님, 괜찮아요. 우리 함께 살아요!"
lines.en: Heungbu smiled and said. "Brother, it's okay. Let's live together!"
segs: Brother, it's okay. Let's live together!

lines.text: 흥부는 쌀자루를 영차영차, 형님네로 보내 주었어요.
lines.en: Heave-ho, heave-ho, Heungbu sent sacks of rice over to his brother's house.
segs: Heave-ho, heave-ho, Heungbu sent sacks of rice over to his brother's house.

lines.text: 놀부는 눈물이 핑 돌아 소매로 슥슥 닦았어요.
lines.en: Tears welled up in Nolbu's eyes, and he wiped them away with his sleeve, swipe, swipe.
segs: Tears welled up in Nolbu's eyes, and he wiped them away with his sleeve, swipe, swipe.

lines.text: 흥부네 집에 모인 두 집안은 다시 한 가족이 되었어요.
lines.en: Together at Heungbu’s home, the two families became one again.
segs: Together at Heungbu’s home, the two families became one again.

lines.text: 두 형제는 손을 꼭 잡고 하하 호호 웃었어요.
lines.en: The two brothers held hands tight and laughed together, ha ha, ho ho.
segs: The two brothers held hands tight and laughed together, ha ha, ho ho.

lines.text: 그날 저녁, 모두 둘러앉아 따끈따끈한 밥을 냠냠 나눠 먹었지요.
lines.en: That evening, everyone sat around together and shared piping hot rice, yum, yum.
segs: That evening, everyone sat around together and shared piping hot rice, yum, yum.

lines.text: 흥부와 놀부는 그 뒤로 사이좋게 오래오래 살았대요. 착한 마음은 복이 되어 돌아와요.
lines.en: After that, Heungbu and Nolbu lived happily together for a very long time. A kind heart brings good fortune back.
segs: After that, Heungbu and Nolbu lived happily together for a very long time. A kind heart brings good fortune back.
